priority_basis: No active continuity-owned item exists in the canonical queue; the highest-risk continuity gap was a prior completion report whose claimed repository artifacts and commits were not observable.
objective: Prevent unverified narrative completion claims from entering durable project memory.

completed_slice.behavior: Fail closed unless each reported artifact has both an observed repository path and an observed commit SHA.

verification.execution_environment: byte-identical local copies before repository commit

shared_state_policy: Additive queue update only; operations/ACTIVE_QUEUE.json, operations/CURRENT_STATE.json, operations/SPECIALIST_REGISTRY.json, and operations/TRIGGER_REQUESTS.json were not overwritten.
next_action: Wire the verifier into any workflow that converts team completion narratives into queue, evidence, or decision-log state.
